'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[July 2023 Jenin incursion]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli military]] withdraws its troops from the [[Jenin refugee camp]] in the occupied [[West Bank]] after two days of [[military operation|operations]], which resulted in the deaths of at least 13 [[Palestinians]], the [[internally displaced person|displacement]] of thousands of people, and widespread damage. An Israeli soldier was also killed. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-66095622 (BBC News)]
*[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**At least 15 [[civilian]]s are killed by [[jihadist]]s in [[Sorgha]], [[Gnagna Province|Gnagna]], [[Burkina Faso]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/civilians-killed-in-burkina-faso-in-suspected-jihadi-attack-/7168452.html (AFP via VOA)]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**At least eight people are killed during an attack at a village in Bungushu, [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230705-at-least-8-dead-in-village-attack-in-eastern-dr-congo (AFP via France 24)]
*[[2023 Kyiv court explosion]]
**Ihor Humenyuk, a [[defendant]] at the [[Shevchenkivskyi District, Kyiv|Shevchenkivskyi]] District Court in [[Kyiv]] and a former member of the [[Sich Battalion]], dies after injuring two police officers in an apparent escape attempt. [https://meduza.io/news/2023/07/05/v-shevchenkovskom-sude-kieva-proizoshel-vzryv (Meduza)]
'''Business and economy'''
*[[Wyloo Metals]], a privately held battery resources unit in Australia, has committed itself to an acquisition of mining company  [[Mincor Resources]], (MCR.AX), its CEO said. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/andrew-forrests-wyloo-looks-more-nickel-deals-it-seals-mincor-buy-2023-07-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Boksburg gas leak]]
**Seventeen people are killed and ten others are hospitalized by a [[nitrate]] [[gas leak]] from [[Illegal mining in South Africa|illegal mining]] in an [[informal settlement]] in [[Boksburg]], [[Gauteng]], [[South Africa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/deaths-toxic-gas-leak-south-africa-a69a73e5c454fdfd7331be873556eab9 (AP)]
*At least 27 people are killed and 17 injured when a bus plunges into a ravine near [[Magdalena Peñasco]], [[Oaxaca]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/5/bus-plunges-into-ravine-in-mexico-killing-as-many-as-27-aboard (Al Jazeera)]
*At least 15 people are killed by [[flash flood]]s caused by torrential rain in [[Chongqing]], [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/chinas-xi-demands-officials-step-up-flood-prevention-measures-during-rain-deluge-2023-07-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Prime Minister of Mongolia|Mongolian prime minister]] [[Luvsannamsrain Oyun-Erdene]] places [[Ulaanbaatar]] on "high alert" due to severe flooding caused by unprecedented rainfall, forcing hundreds of people to [[emergency evacuation|evacuate]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/07/05/world/hundreds-flee-homes-after-flooding-in-mongolias-capital/1899261 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*The [[Icelandic Meteorological Office]] issues a [[Prediction of volcanic activity|volcano warning]] after detecting around 2,200 [[list of earthquakes in Iceland|earthquakes]] around [[Reykjavík]], indicating a potential imminent eruption at [[Fagradalsfjall]]. An [[Volcanic ash and aviation safety|aviation safety alert]] has also been issued. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/07/06/23/hundreds-of-quakes-in-iceland-spur-volcano-warning (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Togo]] confirms 1,450 birds have died after an outbreak of the [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N1]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/togo-reports-outbreak-h5n1-bird-flu-farm-woah-2023-07-05/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Saudi Arabia relations]], [[Iran–Kuwait relations]]
**[[Politics of Saudi Arabia|Saudi Arabia]] announces that it has rejected [[government of Iran|Iranian]] claims to partial ownership of the Durra gas field, following a similar announcement made by [[Government of Kuwait|Kuwait]]. Saudi Arabia and Kuwait plan to jointly develop the [[gas field]]. [https://thecradle.co/article-view/26710/saudi-arabia-rejects-irans-claim-to-arash-gas-field (The Cradle)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/aramco-gulf-operations-kuwait-gulf-oil-company-sign-mou-develop-durra-gas-field-2022-12-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[United States Secret Service]] confirms that [[cocaine]] was discovered in the [[West Wing]] of the [[White House]] on July 1, which led to a brief evacuation of the building. President [[Joe Biden]] has been briefed on the matter. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-66104993 (BBC News)]
*The [[Royal Canadian Mounted Police]] arrest the chief [[propagandist]] for [[neo-Nazi]] group [[Atomwaffen Division]], and [[criminal charge|charge]] him on three counts of [[terrorism in Canada|terrorism]]. [https://www.vice.com/en/article/z3m383/dark-foreigner-arrested-canada-terrorism (''Vice News'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[French space program]]
**[[Aerospace manufacturer]] [[Arianespace]] launches its [[Ariane 5]] [[launch vehicle]] for the final time from the [[Guiana Space Centre]] in [[Kourou]], [[French Guiana]], carrying French and German [[military satellite]]s.
